blocking_failures: structured_data_schema: The instruction says qexec writes tab-separated results but never explicitly lists the output column names, their order, or types. Readers must infer the 5-column schema (partition_key, ts, amount, running_total, rank) from the SQL semantics described. The tests assert exactly 5 tab-separated columns but this schema is not documented as normative in instruction.md.
advice: test_deps_in_image: The Dockerfile installs pandas==2.2.3 and numpy==2.1.3 via pip, but generate_data.py uses only Python stdlib (sqlite3, random, os). These packages are not used anywhere in the image build and appear to be test or development dependencies unnecessarily baked into the image.
